player_prompt.intro:
Uyaphila esitishini eneziboko ez{num_buttons}: {buttons}. Ibhoti leziboko lifaniswa nezifundo zomthetho wobuchwepheshe obufaniswa kodwa obuhlungu; izifundo zibhoti zingafanana.
Kwibhoti leziboko, xa udlala, uyakuthola inkamango enxibelelwanga kuzifundo ezifaniswana.
Uyana nezikhathi zokuthi {num_turns}, kwaye, kuzo zonke izikhathi, uyakwazi ukukhetha ibhoti leziboko na ukupata inkamango.
Ingqeqe yakuwukukhetha izibhoti kwiyeza lezikhathi ukwazi ukuthabatha ulwazi malunga nezifundo zokuthenga kwazo, zokukuthi ukwazi ukukhethe ibhoti leziboko enebunzima eliphezulu kwaye ngemva kwez{num_turns} izigcina.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umdlali akazange aphendule ngefomathi yesenzo esisemthethweni.

game_action.pressed: Ucofe iqhosha {button} waza wafumana umvuzo we-{reward}.

game_message.final_decision: Emva kokuba usebenzise imali yakho ukuzama iindlela ezahlukeneyo uze ubone ukuba ziza kukunceda ngantoni, ngoku cinga ngeyona ndlela ilungileyo.
